channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Harrison Barnes | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Harrison Barnes from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Monte McNair on Harrison Barnes
item.description:
“On the other hand, Harrison’s our oldest rotation player. He just turned 31. … Everybody else is pre-prime or just beginning their prime – 27 or younger. So it’s not like, ‘Oh, we’re gonna bring it together and there’s no real chance of improvement.’”

Monte McNair on Harrison Barnes, Jul 19, 2023. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Draymond Green on Harrison Barnes
item.description:
“I’ve actually never spoken on this before. ButHarrison Barnes, I think to this day, still don’t like me for KD coming [to Golden State]. The reality is, I didn’t tell them to trade you to bring KD in. He took it very personally because of the story that came out that I cried to KD in the car,”

Draymond Green on Harrison Barnes, Apr 26, 2023. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Andrew Bogut on Mike Brown, Harrison Barnes
item.description:
“Mike Brown loves him. I have a feeling they might bring him in. They need someone that’s a pro every day. Harrison Barnes is that guy, but it would help to have another guy like that in the locker room with the young guys.”

Andrew Bogut on Mike Brown, Harrison Barnes, Jul 21, 2022. Source: Fresno Bee.

item.title: Cory Joseph on Harrison Barnes, Bogdan Bogdanovic
item.description:
“After talking to Harrison Barnes, he was telling me what he was trying to do to help, so we were brainstorming, and it just felt like the right thing to do and join my teammates — Bogi (Bogdan Bogdanovic), De’Aaron (Fox), Harrison and Richaun (Holmes) — in trying to donate the meals,”

Cory Joseph on Harrison Barnes, Bogdan Bogdanovic, Apr 16, 2020. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Doug McDermott on Harrison Barnes
item.description:
The Pacers' Doug McDermott plans to capitalize on the Barnes' experience of the country.

“I want to see the buildings, the architecture and get some authentic Indian food. I'm going to try and sneak away Harrison from the Kings for some time so we can go and explore the city a little.”

Doug McDermott on Harrison Barnes, Oct 3, 2019. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Harrison Barnes
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Steve Kerr on his thoughts on Sacramento adding Harrison Barnes:

“I think Harrison is a vet. He's a pro. He'll be great in their locker room. ... It's a really good pickup. He's one of my personal favorites over the years, having coached him. He was just a wonderful human being.”

Steve Kerr on Harrison Barnes, Feb 21, 2019. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Paul Pierce on Jeff Schwartz, Harrison Barnes
item.description:
Paul Pierce:

“It's my understanding this was in the works for the last few days. I got a call from Harrison's agent Jeff Schwartz. They knew something was in the works with Sacramento. And according to my sources, Harrison Barnes wanted to play. It just so happened that during the game, the trade got agreed upon. And so once everybody found out about the trade, they pulled him out. Even though he knew something was in the works, he wanted to play just in case nothing happened.”

Paul Pierce on Jeff Schwartz, Harrison Barnes, Feb 7, 2019. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Harrison Barnes
item.description:
Rick Carlisle:

“I got word of (the trade) during the game and so that is why (Barnes) didn’t play down the stretch, obviously. I had a chance to speak to him before everyone got in the locker room and thanked him for over two and a half great years of being a model pro and being one of the most improved players in the game. I am going to miss him an awful lot. We will miss him an awful lot. But I believe he is going to have a great situation where he is going, and we will just go forward from here. Things are going to look different on the court. We are obviously much smaller. But I believe we have a good group and I believe we can make some noise and we will compete hard.”

Rick Carlisle on Harrison Barnes, Feb 7, 2019. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Dirk Nowitzki, Harrison Barnes
item.description:
Dwain Price:Carlisle on his team:

“I like the group, I like the roster. The fact that we don’t have Dirk (Nowitzki) and (Harrison) Barnes is a big challenge tonight(against Phoenix). We’re going to play our brand of basketball and we’re going to have a chance to win some games.”

Rick Carlisle on Dirk Nowitzki, Harrison Barnes, Oct 17, 2018. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Harrison Barnes
item.description:
Carlisle on Barnes' strained right hamstring:

“He's making good solid progress with no setbacks that I'm aware of. He did pick up his activity and was in more non-contact things. We'll shoot for Friday, which should be a full practice day and see where we are then.”

Rick Carlisle on Harrison Barnes, Oct 16, 2018. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Donnie Nelson on Harrison Barnes, South Africa, Dennis Smith
item.description:
Mavs president of basketball operations Donnie Nelson said.

“I’ve been to Africa on multiple occasions and it is a life-changing experience. I’m really excited that both Dennis and Harrison can have that opportunity.”

Donnie Nelson on Harrison Barnes, South Africa, Dennis Smith, Jul 28, 2018. Source: mavs.com.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Harrison Barnes
item.description:
Dwain Price:Rick Carlisle on Harrison Barnes as the closer for the @Dallas Mavericks:

“He puts the work in, he's had a lot of success for us as the closer and we're going to keep going to him.”

Rick Carlisle on Harrison Barnes, Dec 26, 2017. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Harrison Barnes
item.description:
Earl K. Sneed:Mark Cuban:

“Harrison (Barnes) can add so much more to his game, and I think that's going to be key. ... He can take a quantum leap. If he can take a quantum leap, our team can take a quantum leap. ... That's where he can be our guy.”

Mark Cuban on Harrison Barnes, Apr 4, 2017. Source: Twitter @EarlKSneed.

item.title: Doug McDermott on Harrison Barnes
item.description:
“That actually put a chip on my shoulder to try and improve and try to get to the NBA.Because I knew I wasn't that far behind guys like Harrison.”

Doug McDermott on Harrison Barnes, Mar 5, 2017. Source: Oklahoman.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Harrison Barnes
item.description:
Tim MacMahon:Mark Cuban on Harrison Barnes:

“We've always talked about, when is Dirk going to be our second-best player? I think we're past that now.”

Mark Cuban on Harrison Barnes, Feb 11, 2017. Source: Twitter @espn_macmahon.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Harrison Barnes
item.description:
Earl K. Sneed:Rick Carlisle on Harrison Barnes:

“His work ethic is second to none of any player I’ve ever been around as a player or a coach.”

Rick Carlisle on Harrison Barnes, Feb 10, 2017. Source: Twitter @EarlKSneed.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Harrison Barnes
item.description:
“It wasn’t a matter of interpreting the CBA, it was just a matter of signing guys. But if [Barnes] and Wes turn into cornerstones and we get rolling, we’ll look smart. And if they don’t, we’ll look like idiots. That’s the name of the game.”

Mark Cuban on Harrison Barnes, Jan 26, 2017. Source: Fort Worth Star-Telegram.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Harrison Barnes
item.description:
“Father Time is undefeated and we’ll have to deal with it. I think Harrison [Barnes] is showing a lot of signs that he can be that person. Not to try to put too much pressure on him, but it’s a job he wants and he’s willing to work for it. Hopefully, we’ll be able to add other pieces that are on the same plane.”

Mark Cuban on Harrison Barnes, Nov 19, 2016. Source: Basketball Insiders.

item.title: Channing Frye on Harrison Barnes
item.description:
“Every time I went in the game they put in Harrison Barnes. It was a matchup thing.... I went in, they took their 5-man out, so now they're playing four smalls. That's OK, so then we put in our four smalls. So, it worked. You never hear me complain about playing time, shots. I'm just here to do my job and have fun and just embrace it all.”

Channing Frye on Harrison Barnes, Nov 14, 2016. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Andrew Bogut, Harrison Barnes
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Steve Kerr on Andrew Bogut, Harrison Barnes:

“I'm looking forward to seeing both of them tonight. I've stayed in touch with both of them.”

Steve Kerr on Andrew Bogut, Harrison Barnes, Nov 9, 2016. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Harrison Barnes
item.description:
Tim MacMahon:Rick Carlisle on increased expectations for Harrison Barnes that come along with his max contract:

“I talked to him this summer a lot about that. Bottom line is that it's a challenge that he's got to love to take on. The important thing is that an elevation in responsibility comes at the right rate.”

Rick Carlisle on Harrison Barnes, Sep 26, 2016. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Harrison Barnes
item.description:
Mark Cuban on Harrison Barnes:

“I think his game is going to expand significantly. ...He's going to get asked to do a whole lot more w/ us. I'm not expecting miracles in Year 1 w/ his adjustment period, but he's definitely got the skill set.”

Mark Cuban on Harrison Barnes, Jul 11, 2016. Source: Twitter @EarlKSneed.

item.title: Bob Myers on Harrison Barnes, Festus Ezeli
item.description:
“I know we’re all measured in those (NBA Finals) moments, but both of those guys (Harrison Barnes and Festus Ezeli) have been great for us and have helped us get where we are,”

Bob Myers on Harrison Barnes, Festus Ezeli, Jun 22, 2016. Source: San Francisco Chronicle.

item.title: Andrew Bogut on Harrison Barnes
item.description:
“Harrison has had great games, has had bad games just like anybody else on this roster. So I don’t anticipate it affecting his contract situation.“Someone is going to give him that max, let’s be honest. There’s always a small-market team that would love a guy like Harrison as their No. 1 or No. 2 option. I don’t think it’s going to have any bearing on his financial future and I think people on this team are more valuable than their contract says, just from the basis of what they’ve given up.”

Andrew Bogut on Harrison Barnes, May 8, 2016. Source: Boston Globe.

item.title: Andrew Bogut on Harrison Barnes
item.description:
Tim Kawakami:Andrew Bogut on Harrison Barnes' critics:

“People are idiots... If he's on a bad team, he's averaging 20 a game, you know?”

Andrew Bogut on Harrison Barnes, May 5, 2016. Source: Twitter @timkawakami.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Harrison Barnes
item.description:
Diamond Leung:Steve Kerr on Harrison Barnes:

“I thought he was very consistent until the ankle injury.. I think he's had a really good year overall.”

Steve Kerr on Harrison Barnes, Apr 17, 2016. Source: Twitter @diamond83.

item.title: Andrew Bogut on Harrison Barnes
item.description:
Bogut said Tuesday when asked about Barnes.

“A lot of guys are sacrificing numbers and minutes and roles on this team, and that’s why we’re a great team. Harrison’s had great games, he’s had bad games just like everybody else on this roster. So I don’t anticipate it affecting his contract situation and all that. I mean, someone’s going to be giving him the max. Let’s be honest. Someone’s going to give him close to the max. There’s always a small-market team that would love a guy like Harrison as their No. 1, No. 2 option. So I don’t think it’s going to have any bearing on his financial future.”

Andrew Bogut on Harrison Barnes, Mar 29, 2016. Source: Contra Costa Times.

item.title: Andre Iguodala on Harrison Barnes
item.description:
Iguodala on Barnes, via CSN Bay Area:

“He’s always been a focused player. And coming from where he’s come from, it’s a difficult adjustment – being the man, then kind of taking a step back then they want you take a step forward. He’s handled it like a professional. He’s always kept himself ready. Contract year, so we’re going to continue to help him get as much as possible. He’s a hard-worker, so it’s going to happen for hard workers.”

Andre Iguodala on Harrison Barnes, Nov 23, 2015. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: John Wall on Harrison Barnes
item.description:
Wall even referenced Barnes last week, when asked about the options for the No. 1 pick should the Wizards win the lottery on May 17.

“It’s tough right now because you got guys like Derrick Williams that are good. It depends if guys like Harrison and them come out. I really don’t know,”

John Wall on Harrison Barnes, Apr 18, 2011. Source: Washington Post.
